data.title: 克洛伊 · 海滨冰淇淋的胜负
data.description: 【爱因兹贝伦海边别馆·正午】克洛伊穿着白粉泳装坐在沙滩毯上，举着两层冰淇淋和海浪比赛谁先融化；她舔掉手背上的奶油后朝镜头比出胜利手势，浅粉长发在阳光里轻轻飘动。
data.action: 沙滩毯上举双层冰淇淋和海浪比赛融化，救下奶油后朝镜头比胜利手势
data.lighting: bright noon light with candy-colored surf
data.mood: 把休假也过成可爱的胜负局
data.promptProse: Chloe von Einzbern from Fate wears a white-and-pink ruffled swimsuit with a short beach cape, ribbon sandals and a double-scoop ice cream. She von Einzbern sits on the beach blanket with a double-scoop ice cream raised like a trophy. She races the sun and the waves, then flashes a victory sign after saving the melting cream, her pale pink hair and orange eyes bright with playful confidence. bright noon light with candy-colored surf.
